svg.text: NHE Pi 2x2 Audio: buffer board (one TL074)
High-impedance instrument inputs in front of the PCM1808, and a pad + buffer after the PCM5102. Runs on ±12 V made from the Pi’s 5 V.
TL074 A: input L (pins 1–3) · TL074 B: input R (pins 5–7) · guitar → this → ADC board L / R
TL074 C: output L (pins 8–10) · TL074 D: output R (pins 12–14) · DAC board L / R → this → pedals, amp
Power: ±12 V from the Pi’s 5 V
One supply for the whole unit: the Pi’s USB-C charger. An isolated DC-DC module makes ±12 V; its 0 V joins audio GND.
At the chip: C7 100n from pin 4 to GND and C11 100n from pin 11 to GND. Module draws about 0.25 A from the Pi’s 5 V.
